design.root_cause: Peek applies unrelated XAML DIP and HWND physical-pixel minima.
evidence: Inferred: competing minima cause path-dependent behavior.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Runtime constants are physical pixels while XAML uses separate DIP values.
implementation_steps.change: Expose one canonical physical minimum and explicit conversion requiring active scale.
implementation_steps.code_block:
public static Size GetMinimumSizeInDips(double scale)
+ => new(CanonicalWidthPx / Math.Max(scale, 1), CanonicalHeightPx / Math.Max(scale, 1));

implementation_steps.current_behavior: HWND sizing applies fixed minima independently.
implementation_steps.change: Use canonical physical minima and update them on DPI/monitor changes; initialize XAML from the same conversion.
edge_cases: Do not shrink user sizes above minimum.
tests: Assert minimum track size across monitor scales.

implementation_steps.change: Add focused minimum and image-sizing assertions, skipping mixed-DPI automation where unavailable.

verify: Build Peek with the existing repository build path.
risks: Minimum changes affect every preview type.
Upcoming WASDK APIs may require an adapter, not another source.
alternatives: Change only XAML or only constants; rejected because the other path remains inconsistent.
